name: Isometric Infographic
summary: A system diagram alive as a floating true-isometric diorama: flat three-tone blocks with no outlines on a cream ground, thin ink label pins, Isotype numbers counted in identical cubes, extruded block titles and map-label captions.

palette.use: the ground behind the board, with a faint isometric dot lattice
caption cards, the light face of plates
ink: 3 px infographic lines, labels, numbers
soil mid: the second line of a label
the dark face of cream plates; the dot lattice
red top: red light and the legend chip; the sides of extruded titles
sea blue: blue light only, always the same blue
the orange lane of the spectrum (proposed)
the violet lane of the spectrum (proposed)
the mix target of dark faces; the board's soft shadow

type.case: all caps for titles and labels; sentence case in the caption card
type.emphasis: colour as a legend, a label pin with a row of icons

banned: perspective: the projection is true isometric, axes at 30°, and never rotates or tilts
outlines on solids: they are separated by their three tones only
lighting beyond the three face tones; textures; gradients on solids
a flat 2D explainer, a blueprint or a low-poly 3D island
semi-transparent moving solids: solids arrive by motion, never by alpha
numbers that don't add up: every Isotype count is the real count
copying any game's, explainer channel's or Isotype archive's characters, buildings, icons, palettes or music
